name: site-diary
description: Gujarati-first construction site management for small and mid-size builders

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared -w packages/i18n -w packages/ui-tokens
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:packages && npm run start -w apps/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm test -w packages/shared -w packages/i18n && npm test -w apps/api
scripts.build:mobile-web: npm run build:packages && cd apps/mobile && expo export --platform web
